component.name: Apache CarbonData
component.description: Indexed columnar data format for faster analytics on big data platforms. The project's security page only describes how to report vulnerabilities or potential threats: mail security@apache.org specifying the project name CarbonData with a description of the issue and ideally a way to reproduce it, report privately before any public disclosure, and follow the ASF Security Team process. The page documents no threats, roles, or architectural boundaries.
